controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-07T06:36:53.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T07:36:53.000Z"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, host.name, user.name, url.original, http.request.method, http.response.bytes, squid.elapsed_ms, squid.result_status
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 1000
